ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diagonals AC and BD of the rhombus $ABCD$ intersect at point $O$, and $E$ is the midpoint of $AB$. Line $OE$ is drawn. If $OE = 4$, what is the perimeter of the rhombus $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
it follows that OA=OC, and AB=BC=CD=AD,\\
Since point E is the midpoint of AB,\\
it follows that OE is the median of $\triangle ABC$,\\
hence BC=2OE=8,\\
Therefore, the perimeter of the rhombus ABCD is $8\times 4=\boxed{32}$
